author: thespina
body:
Today on mix Zalatoh was being rude to other players, in particular _xevarq. He kept calling him ez and said he was ez beyond his dreams or something along those lines, he also gave him the "L". Jayster then claimed he should behave since he represents the staff team avicus. Zalatoh said he doesn't have to since he doesn't enforce the rules. 

Here is Evidence: 
http://imgur.com/a/vZZim

it is an album of a few screenies

I'm reporting since I thought all avicus staff, even refs, media, etc, represent the staff team. Plus even if he wasn't staff what he was doing was still rude as a normal player. Any who I told my sister to see if she could punish or do sumthing but she said it is up to the head map dev and told me to report here or msg them, so im assuming i have to wait for whoever dat is before he is punished or warned idk.

In regards,

Alan
